resize: torchvision bicubic antialias uint8; directly from original RGB
grid_policy: H,W multiples32; area within10%; minimize abs(log((W/H)/(sourceW/sourceH))), then relative area error, then H,W
temporal_policy: exact parent frame IDs, source PTS, original frame count; no total video token cap
batch_policy: batch4 only if six prespecified inputs exactly match singleton; otherwise singleton
